(2) The woman smiles broadly and laughs, gesturing toward her chest area with her hands as she speaks to someone off-camera. A black rolling equipment stand and a red paper bag are positioned in the background. (3) The screen transitions to a digital collage of several small video frames and text bubbles over a plain background, showing the woman in various poses. (4) The scene changes to an indoor room with light blue walls and a wooden door. A young man wearing glasses and a dark brown jacket over a hoodie stands next to the woman, holding a pair of pink silicone bra pads. (5) The young man demonstrates the sticky bra by placing it against the woman's chest over her dress and then turns her around to show her back. (6) A final sequence displays a split-screen comparison labeled 'Before' and 'After,' showing the woman's silhouette with and without the product as she laughs and poses.
